Tanguturi Prakasam Pantulu earned the title "Andhra Kesari" during the Simon Commission protests in Madras in 1928. When British police threatened to fire on demonstrators, Prakasam courageously bared his chest and challenged them to shoot him. His fearless act earned him the title "Andhra Kesari" (Lion of Andhra).
Hence, the correct answer is
